findingDetails.title: The no-write test only detects writes inside the fixture repository
findingDetails.scopeProof: Before and after snapshots both receive f.repo; there is no install-root or external-path write guard.
findingDetails.case: A regression writes a marker under the installed .skilled/skills/sk-git tree or /tmp. The fixture repository remains unchanged, so the test passes although the battery wrote a file.
findingDetails.description: The test snapshots the fixture tree including .git and compares local Git config, but it does not observe writes outside f.repo.
findingDetails.recommendation: Observe writes to the install root and other paths the checker can write, or run it under a write-denying fixture sandbox.

findingDetails.title: The planted-helper test can pass without proving the helper-resolution path was exercised
findingDetails.scopeProof: The fixture comment identifies an early install-gate exit; marker absence is asserted without requiring the standards or validator check to have run.
findingDetails.case: Change helper resolution to inspect the target checkout’s planted validator while keeping the fixture on the early install-failure path. The validator marker remains absent and the test passes.
findingDetails.description: The test plants validate-message.mjs, but its comment says the install check exits before reaching the validator in this fixture; assertions do not establish that lookup was reached.
findingDetails.recommendation: Use a fixture that satisfies the install gate and assert the standards or validator result was reached before checking the planted marker.

findingDetails.title: Allowlist verdicts and displayed patterns have separate source-selection logic
findingDetails.scopeProof: Sample verdicts invoke worktree-naming.sh, while report details independently call allowlistFileFor and allowlistPatternsIn.
findingDetails.case: If matcher precedence changes when both .skilled and .opencode allowlist files exist but the duplicate selector does not change, the report can show patterns from a different file than the one used for the verdict.
findingDetails.description: The matcher supplies sample verdicts; a separate local selector and parser supply displayed patterns, creating a silent drift point.
findingDetails.recommendation: Have the matcher expose its selected source and patterns, or add a both-candidate-files regression case that compares the reported source with the matcher.
